name: Gaffr
tagline: Payroll built for the chaos of a shoot day
positioning: Gaffr runs cast and crew payroll for studios and production companies — union math, timecards, and residuals handled from call sheet to wrap.

hero.h1: Payroll that keeps up with the shoot day
hero.sub: From day players to department heads, Gaffr turns timecards, union rates, and box rentals into clean, compliant paychecks — even when the schedule changes twice before lunch.

features.title: Union math, done for you
features.description: IATSE, DGA, SAG-AFTRA, and Teamsters rate tables baked in. Meal penalties, turnaround, and golden hours calculate the moment a timecard lands.

features.title: Timecards from set
features.description: UPMs and 2nd ADs approve digital timecards from the truck. No more chasing paper start slips through three departments after wrap.

features.title: Start paperwork in minutes
features.description: Onboard a 400-person crew with pre-built deal memos, W-4s, and I-9s. Everything routes to the right coordinator automatically.

features.title: Loan-out and residuals ready
features.description: Handle loan-out corporations, fringes, and residual reporting cleanly, so post and accounting aren't reconciling numbers six months later.

features.title: Production accounting sync
features.description: Cost reports map straight to your general ledger and hot costs. Line producers see labor spend by department in real time.

features.title: Multi-state, multi-shoot
features.description: Run splits across states and incentives while Gaffr tracks withholding and location rules for every unit on every day.

testimonials.quote: We closed payroll on a 62-day feature without a single re-issue check. Our accountant used to lose a week to union reconciliation — now it's an afternoon.
testimonials.name: Marissa Delgado

testimonials.quote: The start paperwork alone paid for Gaffr. Onboarding a 300-person background day used to eat two coordinators. Now it's one person and a phone.
testimonials.name: Terrence Yoo

testimonials.quote: Our line producers finally trust the labor numbers mid-week instead of waiting for the weekly. That changes how we make decisions on set.
testimonials.name: Bianca Osei
